review: The Archer class really is made up of Archers. Shi Faust is the first-ever Shi ID released after launch, with a mix of Poise and Bleed. Her gimmick is to use a Defensive Skill to charge up her bow and unleash it to deal damage. An in-depth explanation for this will be given later on. To start her Passive, she does the following: - If she is in the “Ready to Loose” state, it will convert any base attack skill into Skill 3-2. Keep in mind that any Skill converted from this will gain both power and damage boost based on Skill level. “Ready to Loose” status just makes it so that Shi Faust is unable to be staggered through normal means and cannot trigger any form of Assist Attack. This status will also be removed if an E.G.O Skill was equipped. - However, if she has 4 “Target Aim” while Skill 3 is neither on the dashboard nor is the upcoming skill, the Defensive Skill will be counted as Skill
